title: Building Intelligent Research Agents with Manus - Ivan Leo, Manus AI (now Meta Superintelligence)
talk_summary: A live workshop demoing the Manus API: creating async tasks, polling vs webhooks, file/URL/base64 attachments, and wiring a Slack bot that maps threads to Manus task IDs. It is mostly product onboarding for an external agent API, not an account of how Manus builds or operates its own agents.

takeaways.technique: Webhook completion callbacks instead of polling
takeaways.what_they_do: Long-running agent tasks register a webhook; the platform POSTs on task start and completion, so the caller doesn't hold workers polling every 20s.
takeaways.numbers: typical task 3-5 minutes; polling example every 20 seconds

takeaways.technique: Backend router between cheap chat and full agent
takeaways.what_they_do: When no mode is specified, a router decides whether a request needs simple chat or the full agent; users can override with explicit parameters.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we have a router on the back end that tries to determine if you need to use basic simple chat or the full-fledged manus agent

takeaways.what_they_do: Keeping the task ID lets follow-up messages push into the same session so all context stays in one chat rather than being re-sent.
takeaways.evidence_quote: by keeping the task ID around you're able to push to the same session

takeaways.technique: Per-task isolated sandbox with auto-expiring files
takeaways.what_they_do: Every chat/task gets its own sandbox; uploaded files auto-delete after 48h and can be deleted with the session.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every single manage chat ships with its own sandbox

takeaways.what_they_do: Connectors configured once (Gmail, Notion) are referenced by UID in task payloads and work out of the box, avoiding per-task auth setup.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you can use any of these connectors just by copying this UID over here

takeaways.what_they_do: Agent returns generated files with URL, filename, and mime type so downstream code can process them programmatically.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you get back the full file URL the file name the mime type this is really useful if you want to do some sort of processing down the line
